priya.k: hey team — clicked the GitHub invite but it says 'account conflict' and my personal GH account is being attached. I want a separate work account. who should I ping?
matt-peopleops: welcome Priya! pinging IT: @it-support-bot. we usually use the "create new account" invite for separation.
it-support-bot: Hi @priya.k — we can resend as a "require new account" invite which forces the invite to the work email and avoids merge. Quick Q: did you enable 2FA on the work email account you created? the org requires 2FA and SSO.
priya.k: i haven't created the work account yet, i only clicked the invite link and the browser tried to attach to my personal account. please resend as new account flow. also need access to redwood/docs and onboarding.
it-support-bot: Resent (2026-12-12T09:03:10Z) using create-new-account flow, pre-added to docs-readers + onboarding. Accept in an incognito window if your personal account is logged in elsewhere. Note: if you hit SSO pending, complete Okta first.
zack-eng: if you need to start immediately, i can add you as a temporary collaborator to a single repo (inspect only) while IT sorts the org invite — LMK.
priya.k: accepted the new invite but after creating account I got "SSO pending" and can't see private repos (403).
it-support-bot: that means Okta didn't provision your SSO status yet. matt, can you confirm Priya's Okta group?
matt-peopleops: adding Priya to the "engineering-dev" group now. matt: done and triggered SCIM sync.
it-support-bot: SCIM sync kicked at 2026-12-12T09:11:05Z. SSO approved shortly after; teams should appear within a minute.
priya.k: teams visible now, but `git clone git@github.com:redwood/docs.git` fails with "Permission denied (publickey)" — i uploaded an SSH key during account create, not sure why.
devex-lee: run `ssh -T git@github.com -vvv` to see which keys are offered. common issue: ssh-agent is still offering a personal key. either add your work key with `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_work` or add a `~/.ssh/config` block: 
``` 
Host github.com
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_work
```
then retry.
priya.k: fixed agent and can clone now. one last question: how to request write access for a small docs PR?
zack-eng: open infra/repo-access with repo=redwood/docs and brief reason, tag @zack-eng. small docs changes usually approved same-day.
priya.k: filed the request and tagged Zack. thanks everyone! learned to accept invites in incognito if personal GH is logged in. :tada:
